pages.title: Climbing the Ladder
pages.text: Every breed has a $(l)tier$(). Tier 1 breeds spawn in the world. Higher tiers are produced by breeding two specific parents together in a $(l)Chicken Breeder$().$(br2)The higher the tier, the lower the chance a breeding attempt succeeds, so expect to run many cycles for rare breeds.

pages.title: Modded Breeds
pages.text: Many breeds only appear when the mod that provides their drop is installed. If a breed output item cannot be found at load time, that breed is disabled and its children are deferred.$(br2)This is why your available breed list grows as you add mods to the pack.
